Thanks for the report.

This looks like it is about an app built with Electron rather than Electron itself. Problems with a specific app are best reported to that app's developers, who can tell whether Electron is involved.

<sub>Automated first-pass triage. It can only add labels and comment; a maintainer makes every decision, including whether this issue stays open.</sub>
